name: google-calendar-event
title: Calendar Event
description: One event: when, a Join button, Going / Maybe / No for invites, and who is coming. Answers on the user's grant, with no email unless the fork asks for one.

actions.title: Get an event
actions.reason: Reads the guest list before answering, since Google replaces it whole.

actions.title: Update an event
actions.reason: Saves your Going, Maybe or No on an invite.
